text:
incident-bot: 🚨 P1 alert - QuasarCorp (dedicated pool qp-prod-usw2) GPU queueing >95% for 6m, tail latency > 10s. Paging oncall.
eli_oncall: acked. jumping in — can someone paste current pool utilization and the queued job counts?
mike_sre: GPU util: 98% (nvidia-smi avg), driver memory pressure 89%, scheduler queue: 42 waiting, average req latency 9.8s, errors 0.2%. Logs show KV cache thrash on long-context runs.
lina_support: QuasarOps reports customer-facing timeouts on high-throughput endpoints, ~30% 503s in last 10m. Customer POC @quasar_ops_poc on call, they say they saw sudden midday spike tied to nightly batch job.
quasar_ops_poc: that's right — we had a misconfigured batch job that started at 11:46 and kept running parallel inference. We're pausing it now, but need immediate relief for live traffic.
nana_ops_lead: typo: ana_ops_lead here. Options: 1) approve emergency burst to shared overflow for this tenant (30m), 2) scale up dedicated pool by adding reserved nodes (slow), 3) gracefully shed non-live/low-priority jobs for this tenant. Thoughts?
eli_oncall: we should avoid adding nodes (slow). Can we enable burst to shared for QuasarCorp? Need billing/CS signoff but we have emergency override playbook. Any risks to other customers?
mike_sre: shared overflow will route traffic to compatible quantized model variants on different GPU classes. Latency will vary but should reduce queueing. Risk: increased spend and possible small perf regressions for a subset of requests. No data plane isolation issues — traffic encrypted per-customer.
lina_support: I'm looping in CS and billing now, but we can proceed with temporary override if SRE approves. I'll notify Quasar about potential short regressions.
eli_oncall: SRE — please trigger burst override. Runbook: /runbooks/dedicated-pool-burst-override. Command (internal):
```
POST /internal/admin/pools/qp-prod-usw2/burst_override
{
  "tenant": "quasarcorp",
  "duration_min": 30,
  "target_capacity_gpus": 8,
  "reason": "emergency customer-facing impact"
}
```
mike_sre: executing now. applying override -> response 202 accepted. API job id 8a7f. Starting drain of low-priority batch lanes for tenant in parallel.
eli_oncall: monitoring. queue drops from 42 -> 10 within 90s. tail latency -> 3s.
quasar_ops_poc: seeing significant improvement on our end, live endpoints back to normal. thank you.
lina_support: CS notified customer and confirmed acceptance of emergency charge. I'll open a billing ticket to reconcile.
nana_ops_lead: logging decision: burst_override used for 30m. Follow-ups: 1) postmortem with Quasar on their batch job config, 2) recommend rate-limit or backoff in their nightly job, 3) consider autoscale policy tweak for qp-prod-usw2 to add ephemeral burst buffer.
mike_sre: note: created incident runbook event -> incident ID INC-2026-1755012345. Will capture metrics and traces for RCA.
eli_oncall: handing over to night oncall @eli_oncall -> @night_oncall in 15m for monitoring of override expiration. If queueing climbs after revoke, escalate to platform lead.
quasar_ops_poc: thanks team. We'll schedule configuration fix with your solutions engineer.
incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated. Severity downgraded to P2. Override scheduled to auto-revoke at +30m: 1755014145.
eli_oncall: closing active paging. will post postmortem template tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
